card.name: Small words before world or universe
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, that, from, or one, placed where the next word is likely to be world, universe, or a similar sweeping term. Typical in general web prose about history, space, or life on Earth.

modes.label: Superlative then in
modes.description: The word in after a 'most/biggest' phrase, where 'the world' or 'history' is expected next.
modes.example: The situation in Bangladesh has been described as the biggest case of mass poisoning<< in>> recent history.

modes.label: That after claim words
modes.description: The word that after nouns like hypothesis or evidence, introducing a statement about space or life.
modes.example: Panspermia is the hypothesis<< that>> the building blocks for life are found throughout

modes.label: From before universe
modes.description: A preposition where the universe or world is the likely next word.
modes.example: how all the antimatter disappeared<< from>> the universe, leaving only ordinary matter.

card.writes: It nudges the model to produce 'world' words, in English and Chinese, next.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words when a phrase like 'in the world' or 'in the universe' is likely to follow.
